timeline.body: We are investigating reports of impacted performance for some GitHub services.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We are debugging a spike in anonymous traffic. Some users who are not logged in may see errors on the site. CI jobs and release downloads may fail with a 504 Gateway Timeout status if they make anonymous calls.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.

timeline.body: We have observed a repeated increase in 504 errors for anonymous and unauthenticated traffic, including users who are not logged in and release downloads. We are continuing to investigate and apply mitigations.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: On November 9, 2026, GitHub.com experienced intermittent timeouts between approximately 05:10 and 08:15 UTC. Across that full window, 6.5% of recorded requests to github.com timed out, with a five-minute peak of 13.9% between 07:40 and 07:45 UTC. Release downloads were more affected: 38.5% of recorded requests timed out, peaking at 76% during that same five-minute interval. The two main error waves lasted about two hours and ten minutes in total, with recovery between them. The errors affected repository browsing and disrupted some CI workflows and Copilot code review jobs.
